feasibility_reasoning:
The static gate works as described: node run green in 5.8 s, all 19 metrics within budget, `node --test document-weight.test.mjs` 7/7. The negative control is real because inlineStyleCount has max = measured = 50. But six points in the code contradict the mechanism as written:
(1) There is no blocking LH byte comparator. lighthouse-local.mjs:413-427 only prints deltaLine, and its only exitCode=1 is in the exception handler (:504). A new comparator script is needed, and it is not in the file list.
(2) gateCoverage.ts:57 counts only `bun run <script>` inside `run:`, and :178-196 flags duplicates within a job. If the step calls `node scripts/performance/check-document-weight.ts` as written, check:document-weight counts as unwired and check:gate-coverage fails. If both sides go through `bun run check:document-weight`, it is a duplicate and also fails.
(3) The package.json script must run under node, not `bun run` (the file's own Usage line and the house style say bun). artifactServer.ts:214 spawns process.execPath, so under bun the SSR server also runs on bun. Bun's zlib also differs from node's. Measured: htmlGzipBytes 55 432 under bun vs 54 469 under node, against max 55 565 (0.24% headroom). bootClosureGzipBytes is 488 589 vs 485 279.
(4) scripts/verify-static.ts:71-78 pulls in every new check:* unless it is listed in EXCLUDED (:27-56). That file is not in the list, so without an entry the local verify:static throws when .output is missing (artifactServer.ts:175-177).
(5) documentWeight.ts:466 ratchets with Math.min, so "re-ratchet from first runner log" can only lower a budget. A budget that is too tight on the runner needs a hand-edited re-baseline commit.
(6) Smaller wiring issues. The default --json path (check-document-weight.ts:219) means the baseline run overwrites the candidate report. CHROME_PATH in an env: block is orphaned under workflowEnvContract.ts:135-150, so set it via $GITHUB_ENV (as lighthouse.yml:255 does). The default --idle-wait of 180 s per run (lighthouse-local.mjs:99,229-235) can push the job past 35 min: 13.2 min now + 6 runs × 60-90 s + up to 18 min of waiting.
Not a problem: the Supabase URL difference. SUPABASE_PRECONNECT_ORIGIN is hard-coded (src/lib/seo/rootHead.ts:30), so counts stay the same. Also no SSR, i18n, CLS or chunk-graph impact.
blocking_issues: lighthouse-local.mjs has no byte-delta exit path (:413-427, :504). The 'block on scriptTransferBytes/highPriorityBytesBeforeLcpImage > +1%' needs a new comparator script (not in the file list), or the block should be dropped. If kept, it must skip when lcpImageUrl is empty on either side (baseline-h2/mobile-2 gave 0.0 KB).

check:gate-coverage: the candidate must be invoked exactly once as `bun run check:document-weight -- --root ../candidate`. The baseline goes through `node scripts/performance/check-document-weight.ts --root ../baseline --json reports/document-weight-baseline.json || true`. The mechanism's `node ...` form leaves the gate unwired (gateCoverage.ts:57).

The package.json script must be `node scripts/performance/check-document-weight.ts`, not `bun run ...`. Under bun the gzip semantics and SSR runtime change (htmlGzipBytes 55 432 vs max 55 565 under bun, vs 54 469 under node), which makes the gate one small PR away from red.
scripts/verify-static.ts EXCLUDED needs a check:document-weight entry (requires a build). Otherwise the local verify:static/verify:blocking breaks.
The ratchet is min-only (documentWeight.ts:466). If node 24.19 on the runner measures above max, the fix is an explicit justified re-baseline commit, not --ratchet.
Pass `--idle-wait 30` (or a higher --max-load) to lighthouse-local in CI, or the 35-min timeout is reachable. Set CHROME_PATH via $GITHUB_ENV, not env: (workflow-env-contract).
effect_reasoning:
This is a guardrail with 0 direct score points.

What it protects: one extra 20 KB-gzip modulepreload on the shared h2 pipe at 1.6 Mb/s (≈200 KB/s) delays the LCP image by about 100 ms on mobile. The static gate already catches that deterministically in about 6 s: preloadedJsCount is exact and preloadedJsGzipBytes has 2% headroom.

The LH byte block is redundant. highPriorityBytesBeforeLcpImage (618.3 KB) is roughly preloadedJsGzipBytes (548.6 KB) plus render-blocking CSS and fonts, all statically gated. scriptTransferBytes overlaps check:bundle. Neither adds a regression class worth 7-10 runner minutes per PR (6 runs × 60-90 s plus npx and setup).

The timing DELTA line is unreliable at n=3 on a 4-vCPU runner:
- A/A gives TBT ±464 ms and perf −13.
- Mobile FCP is bimodal (2.88-2.99 s vs 4.06-4.26 s), so a median can jump about 1.1 s on one race.
- A runner's benchmarkIndex is not PSI's.

Per-PR visibility of document weight is real and cheap. The LH A/B adds cost and noise, not score.

Cheaper alternative with the same protection: keep the blocking static gate on node plus the unit test (+≈10 s). Make LH A/B report-only with n=5, path-filtered to src/**, vite*.config.ts and package.json (or label-triggered), with --idle-wait 30, and no LH byte block.
corrected_estimate:
Score effect: 0 (prevention only).
Static gate: 2 × ≈6 s, deterministic under node. It blocks structural regressions (inline style/script, state, preload count and duplicates, boot raw/gzip, High JS pool, render-blocking CSS).
LH A/B mobile 3+3: +7-10 min, so the job goes from 13.2 to about 21-24 min (worst case ≈42 min with the default idle-wait 180 s, so cap it at 30 s).
LH byte block: 0 additional coverage over the static gate, with a small false-block risk when the LCP image is unresolved.
Required edits beyond the stated files: scripts/verify-static.ts EXCLUDED; a new LH comparator script (or drop the block); package.json script must use node; one `bun run check:document-weight` per job.
better_alternative: Make check:document-weight = `node scripts/performance/check-document-weight.ts`. Invoke it once via `bun run check:document-weight -- --root ../candidate` (blocking). Run the baseline via `node ... --root ../baseline --json reports/document-weight-baseline.json || true`. Run `node --test document-weight.test.mjs` next to line 47. Add the EXCLUDED entry in verify-static.ts. Make the LH A/B report-only (n=5, --idle-wait 30, path filter or label) with no byte block, since highPriorityBytesBeforeLcpImage and scriptTransferBytes are already covered by preloadedJsGzipBytes and check:bundle.
